scope.goal: Compare reservation ownership across a monolith and separate services.

gaps.label: Deployment routing unavailable
gaps.note: Reviewed synthetic source and manifests only; actual routing or worker activation is not established.

nodes.label: Partner retry worker
nodes.evidenceGap: Mentioned in the fictional handoff notes; no corresponding source locator was supplied.

correspondences.label: Request ownership starts at the endpoint
correspondences.note: Each entry accepts and validates the reservation request. They do not call across repositories.

correspondences.label: One module, two service responsibilities
correspondences.note: One monolith module owns holding a slot and confirming the reservation; the reference splits the same responsibilities.

correspondences.label: Cancellation audit not matched in reviewed paths
correspondences.note: Reference API and confirmation service sources were checked for a cancellation audit writer. Neither inspected path provided a match. Other services were outside scope.

correspondences.label: Partner retries remain unverified
correspondences.note: The worker was mentioned, but no source, configuration, or own-side counterpart was established.

evidence.supports: Routes validated creation requests into the reservation module.
Holds a window and confirms the reservation in one module.
evidence.limits: No transaction isolation behavior was measured.

evidence.supports: Records cancellation transitions in an audit sink.
evidence.limits: The retention policy was not inspected.

evidence.supports: Accepts reservation requests and depends on the availability client.
Issues an identifier for a held slot and forwards it to confirmation.
evidence.limits: Service communication was not observed at runtime.

evidence.supports: Consumes held-slot identifiers and commits confirmations. No cancellation audit writer is present in this inspected path.
evidence.limits: Other services and deployed sidecars are not covered.

overview.label: Architecture overview
overview.note: Application responsibilities are compared with their service counterparts.

candidates.title: Revisit partner retry ownership
candidates.evidenceGap: Neither a concrete retry entry point nor deployed worker configuration was supplied.
candidates.fact: This report has no anchored retry trace for either repository.
candidates.inference: Moving responsibilities before the boundary is traced would risk duplicating retries.
candidates.recommendation: Keep the current design and gather static evidence before comparing alternatives.
candidates.benefit: Unknown until ownership and failure handling are documented.
candidates.license: No code reuse or distribution change proposed.

tasks.title: Trace configured retry ownership
tasks.action: Locate registry and configuration entries naming the retry worker, then trace each repo from entry point to ownership.
tasks.condition: Revisit when there is a recheckable source and configuration anchor for both repositories.
